name: applyRenameH2ToH3 demotes the script's own injected anchor
why: THE defect. Demoting the anchor defeats applyInsertH2()'s own marker guard — its query looks for an h2 carrying the marker and finds an h3 — so a second heading is injected and the original element leaves the document. A COUNT of anchors stays 1 throughout, because renderGroupedTable()'s cleanup sweeps the orphan, which is why this went unnoticed and why the spec pins element IDENTITY instead.

name: the exclusion is widened to every h2, so native headings survive too
why: Counter-guard in the other direction. Excluding too much would stop the feature doing its job — demoting MusicBrainz's own section headings is the entire point of renameH2ToH3, and the multi-table machinery expects h3 siblings.

name: applyRenameH2ToH1 loses the same exclusion
why: KNOWN GAP, recorded rather than hidden. user-edits and user-open-edits declare renameH2ToH1 AND insertH2 together, so they carry the identical hazard — but no committed fixture covers either pageType, and user-open-edits' snapshot is a rendered baseline rather than a driveable fixture. Covering it needs a user-edits fixture plus a login-gated capture.
